description:

The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. title: Assoc Systems Engineer
description:

 ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success.  Purpose of the Systems Engineer Role
   

  

 Implements, configures and contributes to the design of moderately complex systems for internal and external customers. Assists in performing analysis on existing systems as well as overall system maintenance. Determines system specifications, input/output processes and working parameters for hardware/software compatibility. Coordinates subsystem design and total system integration. Identifies, analyzes, and resolves program support deficiencies and develops recommended corrective actions.

 \\- JIRA
   

  

  

 \\- Confluence
   

  

  

 \\- Comforte
   

  

  

 \\- Protegrity
   

  

  

 \\- IgNio
   

  

  

 Core Capabilities

 \\- Drive Results – consistently achieving outcomes even under tough circumstances.
   

  

  

 \\- Customer Focus – building strong customer relationships and delivering customer‑centric solutions.
